pipeline_scope: model metadata + weights only: names, const-tensor byte ranges, fp16 payloads and proven I/O shapes for hed_model / enhance_model / dewarp_fine_model. No operator graph, so no inference.
notes: The embedded MACE models ARE separable (contradicts the earlier 'not separable' entry): the description region 0x16020d8..0x160cb60 holds five self-delimiting blocks, each [u32 0, u32 payload_bytes][NUL-terminated name stream][16-byte u64 record table]; the six weight buffers are at 0x4387CC, 0x4C5CB0, 0x608E28, 0x74BFB4, 0xA50A98, 0x14CEF8C and tile 0x4387CC..0x16020D4 exactly (18,650,700 B of payload + 700 B of alignment gaps).

Record law proven: u64 byte_offset + u64 fp16_element_count, body = 2*count bytes, verified by zero-gap packing and by trailer==max_tensor_end for 4 of 5 blocks (slack 2/0/0/0 B, coverage 1.0). The 5th block (model.conv1/res/deres autoencoder) has 0x120000 B of undeclared tail = exactly two 0x90000-element tensors.

The payload bases are proven from six constant-returning getters in .text (adrp x0/add/ret paired with movz/movk/ret 12 bytes later) that are called from the MacePlatform loader at 0xafbb0; nothing else in the image points at the weights.
The 0x4D3700..0x78C700 region previously described as int8-with-0x80-zero-point is fp16; 0x8000 is -0.0 and is used as padding inside the weight buffers.

Tensor identification: block 4 = hed_model (EdgeDet/MobilenetV1 names, pred_segment output, descriptor 1x384x384x3 -> 1x384x384x2); block 1 = the dewarp pair (dewarp_* / net.latlayer* names, one table, two identical-size payloads reached by switch cases 2 and 3); blocks 0/2 = the two inference/generator nets (enhance vs demoire unresolved); block 3 = the largest (11 MB) resnet autoencoder, switch case 8.
No inference is claimed or implemented: reimpl/mace_loader.py decodes names, tables, fp16 tensors and reports shapes; graph_decoded=false, inference_available=false.
blockers: operator graph: no MACE NetDef/protobuf exists in the image (model names occur only as C strings; 0x0a/0x22-framed occurrences = 0 for every model/op name). MacePlatform builds a MultiNetDef object at run time (loader 0xafbb0, per-case builders 0xb16ac/0xb1840/0xb19d4/0xb1b68/0xb1cfc/0xb1e90 logging 'Create multi net '), but the graph source is not statically present

the five description blocks are referenced by no instruction, relocation, GOT entry, literal pool or movz/movk constant (evidence/mace_refscan.txt); the net_def argument to engine_->Init comes from a .bss registry at 0x17ee418, filled at run time

which of the two identical-size dewarp payloads (0x4C5CB0 / 0x608E28) is coarse vs fine is unknown — same table, same size, no name link
